Build Docker image locally or on a non-TACC builder, push to GHCR, then pull to .sif from a TACC compute-node job.
Do not run apptainer pull/build/exec on TACC login nodes; use the generated pull/smoke Slurm scripts or an idev allocation.
Slurm jobs run the synced remote repo under $WORK/projects/<project> and put active outputs under $SCRATCH/runs.
